title: Stage-10 write authority and retrieval trust (recovered defects)
note: These guards were recovered from tests/test_agent_authority_boundaries.py in the PR #16 corpus, which proved current main had lost them: the Stage-10 writers overwrote README.md and wrote {"status": "PASS"} into results_gate_table.csv during an ordinary test run, and load_index accepted a rewritten index as authoritative. Each mutation below reopens one of those holes.

mutations.name: W1_workspace_boundary_not_enforced
mutations.find:
if p != ws and ws not in p.parents:
        _refuse(p, what)
mutations.rationale: every location becomes writable; the allowlist stops existing

mutations.name: W2_text_writer_skips_the_guard
mutations.rationale: THE ORIGINAL DEFECT: the writer takes any path and calls write_bytes, so the guard is advisory and a caller who forgets it overwrites canonical state

mutations.name: W3_guard_output_dir_skips_the_check
mutations.find:
p = assert_in_workspace(out_dir, what="output directories")
    p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
mutations.rationale: governed directories and directory symlinks escaping the workspace are created and returned as valid output locations

mutations.name: W4_relpath_launders_external_paths
mutations.find:
raise ValueError(
            f"{p} is outside the repository; refusing to record it as a "
            "repository-relative path") from exc
mutations.rationale: /etc/secret.md is laundered into secret.md, so a provenance record names a repository file that is not the file the bytes came from

mutations.name: R1_absolute_corpus_path_accepted
mutations.rationale: the corpus root stops deciding what is in the corpus

mutations.name: R2_path_traversal_accepted
mutations.find: if any(part in ("..", ".") for part in parts):
mutations.rationale: '..' escapes the corpus root and reads files retrieval was never given

mutations.name: R3_excluded_dirs_ignored
mutations.find: if any(part in EXCLUDED_DIRS for part in parts):
mutations.rationale: generated, untracked and non-governed trees enter retrieval wearing a governed label

mutations.name: R4_non_document_suffix_accepted
mutations.rationale: arbitrary file types are indexed as governed text documents

mutations.name: R5_corpus_symlink_followed
mutations.rationale: the link target, chosen by whoever can write the directory, is indexed under a name the corpus root implies

mutations.name: R6_duplicate_corpus_entries_accepted
mutations.rationale: one file counted twice silently doubles its weight in the ranking

mutations.name: R7_corpus_root_escape_accepted
mutations.find: if resolved != root_resolved and root_resolved not in resolved.parents:
mutations.rationale: a path resolving outside the corpus root is indexed anyway

mutations.name: R8_serialized_index_trusted_verbatim
mutations.rationale: THE OTHER RECOVERED DEFECT: a rewritten index puts words into a governed document's mouth with impeccable-looking provenance

mutations.name: R9_k_type_not_checked
mutations.find: if isinstance(k, bool) or not isinstance(k, int):
mutations.rationale: a silently coerced k changes how much of the corpus a reader is handed

mutations.name: R10_k_bounds_not_checked
mutations.rationale: retrieval becomes an unbounded corpus dump

mutations.name: R11_file_digests_shape_not_checked
mutations.find: if not isinstance(stored_digests, dict) or not all(
mutations.rationale: a malformed digest map is fed into the rebuild path
